definitions.explanation: A decentralized, distributed digital ledger technology that records transactions across multiple computers in a way that makes the records difficult to alter retroactively.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: From English "blockchain." The name comes from how data is organized: transactions are grouped into "blocks" that are cryptographically linked together in a "chain."

TECHNICAL FEATURES:
・⟦{分散型|ぶんさんがた}→分散型：29681_bunsangata⟧ (distributed/decentralized)
・⟦{改竄|かいざん}→改竄：07943_kaizan⟧⟦{不能|ふのう}→不能：28353_funou⟧ (tamper-proof)
・⟦{透明性|とうめいせい}→透明性：05576_toumeisei⟧ (transparency)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・ブロックチェーン⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (blockchain technology)
・ブロックチェーン⟦{上|じょう}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (on the blockchain)
・ブロックチェーン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧ (to utilize blockchain)
・ブロックチェーン⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧ (blockchain platform)

APPLICATIONS: Originally developed for Bitcoin, blockchain technology is now used in supply chain management, digital identity verification, smart contracts, NFTs (non-fungible tokens), and various other applications beyond cryptocurrency.
